title: Guha narrates Bharata about Rama's stay
introduction: Guha reports to Bharata, how Rama and his party broke their journey at Shringaverapura and narrate to him the dialogue that took place between Lakshmana and himself during that night. Guha further tells him how Rama and Lakshmana matted their hair into a thick mass crossed the holy river with Seetha and left for the hermitage of Sage Bharadwaja.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षडशीतितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 86th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
आचचक्षे अथ सद्भावम् लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः |
भरताय अप्रमेयाय गुहो गहन गोचरः
verses.iast:
ācacakṣe atha sadbhāvam lakṣmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ |
bharatāya aprameyāya guho gahana gocaraḥ
verses.translation: Then Guha the foremost dweller reported Bharata, who was having incomprehensible qualities, about the quality of goodness of Lakshmana(as follows):

verses.devanagari:
तम् जाग्रतम् गुणैर् युक्तम् वर चाप इषु धारिणम् |
भ्रातृ गुप्त्य् अर्थम् अत्यन्तम् अहम् लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवम्
verses.iast:
tam jāgratam guṇair yuktam vara cāpa iṣu dhāriṇam |
bhrātṛ gupty artham atyantam aham lakṣmaṇam abravam
verses.translation: "I spoke as follows to that Lakshmana, who is endowed with virtues and wielding arrows bow and a sword and who was keeping a vigil for the safe guard of his brother."

glosses.meaning: for the sake guard of his brother.

verses.devanagari:
इयम् तात सुखा शय्या त्वद् अर्थम् उपकल्पिता |
प्रत्याश्वसिहि शेष्व अस्याम् सुखम् राघव नन्दन
verses.iast:
iyam tāta sukhā śayyā tvad artham upakalpitā |
pratyāśvasihi śeṣva asyām sukham rāghava nandana
verses.translation: "O, dear brother! Here is a comfortable bed made ready for you. Feel yourself at ease. Rest peacefully on this, O, delight of the Raghu race!"

glosses.meaning: O dear broter! Raaghavanandana = a delight to those born in Raghu dynasty! Iyam = Here is

verses.devanagari:
उचितो अयम् जनः सर्वे दुह्खानाम् त्वम् सुख उचितः |
धर्म आत्ममः तस्य गुप्त्य् अर्थम् जागरिष्यामहे वयम्
verses.iast:
ucito ayam janaḥ sarve duhkhānām tvam sukha ucitaḥ |
dharma ātmamḥ tasya gupty artham jāgariṣyāmahe vayam
verses.translation: "All my people are habituated for hardships, o virtuous prince! You are used to comfort. Hence ,we shall keep awake for the safe guard of Rama."

verses.devanagari:
न हि रामात् प्रियतरो मम अस्ति भुवि कश्चन |
मा उत्सुको भूर् ब्रवीम्य् एतद् अप्य् असत्यम् तव अग्रतः
verses.iast:
na hi rāmāt priyataro mama asti bhuvi kaścana |
mā utsuko bhūr bravīmy etad apy asatyam tava agrataḥ
verses.translation: "None is more dear to me than Rama on this earth. Moreover, do not become restless. I am telling this truth in your presence."

verses.devanagari:
अस्य प्रसादाद् आशंसे लोके अस्मिन् सुमहद् यशः |
धर्म अवाप्तिम् च विपुलाम् अर्थ अवाप्तिम् च केवलाम्
verses.iast:
asya prasādād āśaṃse loke asmin sumahad yaśaḥ |
dharma avāptim ca vipulām artha avāptim ca kevalām
verses.translation: "By the grace of Rama, I wish to attain a very great renown in this earth, an extensive acquisition of righteousness, an unalloyed wealth and enjoyment."

verses.devanagari:
सो अहम् प्रिय सखम् रामम् शयानम् सह सीतया |
रक्षिष्यामि धनुष् पाणिः सर्वैः स्वैर् ज्नातिभिः सह
verses.iast:
so aham priya sakham rāmam śayānam saha sītayā |
rakṣiṣyāmi dhanuṣ pāṇiḥ sarvaiḥ svair jnātibhiḥ saha
verses.translation: "I as such with a bow in my hand, along with my relatives will guard my dear friend Rama, who slept together with Seetha."

glosses.meaning: with a bow in my hand

verses.devanagari:
न हि मे अविदितम् किंचिद् वने अस्मिमः चरतः सदा |
चतुर् अन्गम् ह्य् अपि बलम् प्रसहेम वयम् युधि
verses.iast:
na hi me aviditam kiṃcid vane asmimḥ carataḥ sadā |
catur angam hy api balam prasahema vayam yudhi
verses.translation: "Nothing is indeed unknown to me, who forever wander in this forest. We can defeat even an army consisting of all the four limbs in battle."

glosses.meaning: even an army consisting of all the four limbs

verses.devanagari:
एवम् अस्माभिर् उक्तेन लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना |
अनुनीता वयम् सर्वे धर्मम् एव अनुपश्यता
verses.iast:
evam asmābhir uktena lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā |
anunītā vayam sarve dharmam eva anupaśyatā
verses.translation: "Thus spoken as aforesaid by us the high soled Lakshmana, who perceives righteousness alone,politely replied to all of us( as follows)

verses.devanagari:
कथम् दाशरथौ भूमौ शयाने सह सीतया |
शक्या निद्रा मया लब्धुम् जीवितम् वा सुखानि वा
verses.iast:
katham dāśarathau bhūmau śayāne saha sītayā |
śakyā nidrā mayā labdhum jīvitam vā sukhāni vā
verses.translation: "How is it possible for me to get a sleep, or even life or comforts when Rama is reposing on the floor along with Seetha?"

verses.devanagari:
यो न देव असुरैः सर्वैः शक्यः प्रसहितुम् युधि |
तम् पश्य गुह सम्विष्टम् तृणेषु सह सीतया
verses.iast:
yo na deva asuraiḥ sarvaiḥ śakyaḥ prasahitum yudhi |
tam paśya guha samviṣṭam tṛṇeṣu saha sītayā
verses.translation: "O, Guha! Behold that Rama, who cannot be conquered in a battle even by all the celestials and demons, sleeping on the blades of grass along with Seetha."

verses.devanagari:
महता तपसा लब्धो विविधैः च परिश्रमैः |
एको दशरथस्य एष पुत्रः सदृश लक्षणः
verses.iast:
mahatā tapasā labdho vividhaiḥ ca pariśramaiḥ |
eko daśarathasya eṣa putraḥ sadṛśa lakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "This Rama is an excellent son, having qualities equal to those of Dasaratha. The king obtained Rama by performing a great penance and after facing various troubles."

verses.devanagari:
अस्मिन् प्रव्राजिते राजा न चिरम् वर्तयिष्यति |
विधवा मेदिनी नूनम् क्षिप्रम् एव भविष्यति
verses.iast:
asmin pravrājite rājā na ciram vartayiṣyati |
vidhavā medinī nūnam kṣipram eva bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "When Rama having seen exiled, the king Dasaratha will not survive for long.This earth will surely be without a husband soon."

verses.devanagari:
विनद्य सुमहा नादम् श्रमेण उपरताः स्त्रियः |
निर्घोष उपरतम् नूनम् अद्य राज निवेशनम्
verses.iast:
vinadya sumahā nādam śrameṇa uparatāḥ striyaḥ |
nirghoṣa uparatam nūnam adya rāja niveśanam
verses.translation: "The women in the gynoecium's, having cried with a great noise, would have ceased their crying out of fatigue. Now, the great noise would have stopped in the royal palace by now."

verses.devanagari:
कौसल्या चैव राजा च तथा एव जननी मम |
न आशंसे यदि ते सर्वे जीवेयुः शर्वरीम् इमाम्
verses.iast:
kausalyā caiva rājā ca tathā eva jananī mama |
na āśaṃse yadi te sarve jīveyuḥ śarvarīm imām
verses.translation: "I do not expect whether all of them, like Kausalya Dasaratha and even my mother Sumitra will survive at all till this night."

verses.devanagari:
जीवेद् अपि हि मे माता शत्रुघ्नस्य अन्ववेक्षया |
दुह्खिता या तु कौसल्या वीरसूर् विनशिष्यति
verses.iast:
jīved api hi me mātā śatrughnasya anvavekṣayā |
duhkhitā yā tu kausalyā vīrasūr vinaśiṣyati
verses.translation: "By beholding Shatrughna, my mother perhaps may even survive. However, the afflicted Kausalya who gave birth to the eminent Rama will surely die."

glosses.meaning: who gave birth to the eminent Rama

verses.devanagari:
अतिक्रान्तम् अतिक्रान्तम् अनवाप्य मनो रथम् |
राज्ये रामम् अनिक्षिप्य पिता मे विनशिष्यति
verses.iast:
atikrāntam atikrāntam anavāpya mano ratham |
rājye rāmam anikṣipya pitā me vinaśiṣyati
verses.translation: Without realising his long-cherished wish and failing to install Rama in the kingdom of Aodhya, my father Dasaratha will expire."

glosses.meaning: and having not been able to install

verses.devanagari:
सिद्ध अर्थाः पितरम् वृत्तम् तस्मिन् काले ह्य् उपस्थिते |
प्रेत कार्येषु सर्वेषु संस्करिष्यन्ति भूमिपम्
verses.iast:
siddha arthāḥ pitaram vṛttam tasmin kāle hy upasthite |
preta kāryeṣu sarveṣu saṃskariṣyanti bhūmipam
verses.translation: "Those who have accomplished their purpose (Shatrughna and others) will perform all the funeal honours to king Dasaratha, my father when the time comes for it."

glosses.meaning: are indeed they who accomplished their purpose.

verses.devanagari:
रम्य चत्वर संस्थानाम् सुविभक्त महा पथाम् |
हर्म्य प्रासाद सम्पन्नाम् सर्व रत्न विभूषिताम्
गज अश्व रथ सम्बाधाम् तूर्य नाद विनादिताम् |
सर्व कल्याण सम्पूर्णाम् हृष्ट पुष्ट जन आकुलाम्
आराम उद्यान सम्पूर्णाम् समाज उत्सव शालिनीम् |
सुखिता विचरिष्यन्ति राज धानीम् पितुर् मम
verses.iast:
ramya catvara saṃsthānām suvibhakta mahā pathām |
harmya prāsāda sampannām sarva ratna vibhūṣitām
gaja aśva ratha sambādhām tūrya nāda vināditām |
sarva kalyāṇa sampūrṇām hṛṣṭa puṣṭa jana ākulām
ārāma udyāna sampūrṇām samāja utsava śālinīm |
sukhitā vicariṣyanti rāja dhānīm pitur mama
verses.translation: "They will joyfully inhabit my father capital City, with its pleasant cross roads and meeting places, with its main roads well laid out, sumptuous with large houses and lofty mansions, with all the gems they are encrusted, with elephants horses and chariots that abound there, the sound of trumpets with which the city resonates, the many diversions it contains, its properous and well-fed people, its luxurious gardens and parks as well as the assmeblies and festivals that continuously take place inti."

glosses.meaning: with its pleasant cross roads and meeting places
with its main roads well laid-out
sumptous with large houses and lofty mansions
and all the gems with which they are encrusted
with the elephants horses and chariots that abound there
the sound of trumpets with which it resonates
the assemblies and festivals that continuously take place in it.

verses.devanagari:
अपि सत्य प्रतिज्नेन सार्धम् कुशलिना वयम् |
निवृत्ते समये ह्य् अस्मिन् सुखिताः प्रविशेमहि
verses.iast:
api satya pratijnena sārdham kuśalinā vayam |
nivṛtte samaye hy asmin sukhitāḥ praviśemahi
verses.translation: Shall we enter Ayodhya happily along with that virtuous Rama, who has truly redeemed his promise, when he completed his term of exile?

glosses.meaning: who is true to his promise

verses.devanagari:
परिदेवयमानस्य तस्य एवम् सुमहात्मनः |
तिष्ठतो राज पुत्रस्य शर्वरी सा अत्यवर्तत
verses.iast:
paridevayamānasya tasya evam sumahātmanaḥ |
tiṣṭhato rāja putrasya śarvarī sā atyavartata
verses.translation: While that magnamimous prince was lamenting thus, standing guard, the night passed.

verses.devanagari:
प्रभाते विमले सूर्ये कारयित्वा जटा उभौ |
अस्मिन् भागीरथी तीरे सुखम् सम्तारितौ मया
verses.iast:
prabhāte vimale sūrye kārayitvā jaṭā ubhau |
asmin bhāgīrathī tīre sukham samtāritau mayā
verses.translation: "When the sun rose brightly in the next morning Rama and Lakshmana got their locks of hair matted into a thick mass at the banks of River Ganga and they were safely ferried by me."

glosses.meaning: got their locks of hair matted
at the banks of River Ganga

verses.devanagari:
जटा धरौ तौ द्रुम चीर वाससौ |
महा बलौ कुन्जर यूथप उपमौ |
वर इषु चाप असि धरौ परम् तपौ |
व्यवेक्षमाणौ सह सीतया गतौ
verses.iast:
jaṭā dharau tau druma cīra vāsasau |
mahā balau kunjara yūthapa upamau |
vara iṣu cāpa asi dharau param tapau |
vyavekṣamāṇau saha sītayā gatau
verses.translation: "Rama and Lakshmana, who were capable of tormenting their enemies, possessing great strength, wearing matted locks of hari and clothes made of bark, like unto the leaders of herd of elephants, wielding excellent bow, arrows and sword, looking back at me, went away with Seetha.

glosses.meaning: like unto the leaders of a herd of elephants
